payload.toolName: Compress PDF to 500KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.description: Free no-signup browser PDF compressor for strict 500KB upload limits on forms, exam portals, school uploads, application portals, and email-style document limits. It keeps ordinary files local during use and includes an optional public-safe USD 9 upload fix-plan request only after users confirm fit.
payload.keyFeatures: No signup. Browser-based PDF compression. 500KB target page. No server file upload for ordinary use. Free export path. Optional public-safe upload fix-plan request is separate.
payload.additionalNotes: Specific free upload-limit tool submission. The page is useful for people searching exact 500KB PDF errors and is not a paid-only product.
